reply_text:
The Door 6 gatehouse tablet issue at Tansleigh Packaging is ticket #88412. I've replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2 July 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation. Hollis is a member of that channel. The tablet froze when scanning BOL barcodes (bill of lading), and it happened when Quarendon Freightways drivers arrived with split manifests.

In the reply I also warned Hollis not to mix it up with #8841. Tobias mentioned that ticket in #central-random yesterday, and it's a different issue: the West yard Door 2 double-booking.

Ticket numbers are operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed.
